Hetzner.summary_note: Hetzner is a strong baseline EU-sovereign option with full German family ownership (no external investors, no stock listing), ISO 27001:2022, and BSI C5 Type 2 (2026). Its in-house server assembly in Gunzenhausen is unusual and adds hardware traceability. Key weaknesses are: no customer-managed KMS product for block storage, no GAIA-X membership, US and Singapore cloud locations exist on the same platform (requiring active EU-region selection by customers), and limited customer-facing security audit tooling. Environmental credentials are genuinely strong with a PUE of 1.13 and 100% renewable electricity since 2008. The provider is well suited for budget-conscious EU deployments needing solid legal sovereignty under German law, but is not appropriate for use cases requiring EUCS High certification, customer-held encryption keys out of the box, or formal GAIA-X compliance.
